questions: What is spin?
If the spin is reversed, does it start turning the other way?
What is coherence?
If coherence is lost, does everything become random?
What is a pulse?
After the pulse passes, is nothing left changed?
What is a transition?
After the transition finishes, does it remain in the new state?
What is a memory?
When the memory is read, is it gone?
What is a dark state?
If something is in a dark state, is it impossible to detect?
What is excitation?
After the excitation dies down, is it necessarily back where it started?
What is a line?
If a line splits, has one thing become two?
What is contrast?
If the contrast disappears, are the two things the same?
What is a threshold?
Once the threshold is crossed, does it stay crossed?
What is a beat?
If the beat speeds up, must whatever made it be moving faster?
What is an echo?
If an echo comes back later, did it have to bounce off something?
What is a trap?
If a trap is made deeper, does it always hold things longer?
What is a comb?
If a comb has more teeth, does it always separate things more finely?
What is dressing?
If the dressing is taken off, is the original state necessarily restored?
